annotations.title: Say which bank rows pay a card

description: Say that a bank merchant pays a credit card — **a list in one call**. Give the bank `transaction_id` and the `card_account_id` it pays (ids from `document_info`); omit the card to take the answer back. This is *This pays a card* on a Transactions row and on a By merchant row. Optionally `counts` says whether those bank rows count in the totals: false leaves them out, because the card’s own rows already hold that money. **Dry-runs by default**; commit with `commit: true` once the user has said yes.

commit.description: Default false. False previews and writes nothing; true makes the change.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

payments.description: One entry per bank merchant. Up to 200 in a call.

card_account_id.description: The credit-card account it pays. Omit for *not a card payment*.

counts.description: Whether the bank rows that pay the card count in totals. Omit to keep the card’s answer.

transaction_id.description: A bank row of the merchant, from `transactions`.

name: set_card_payers
